subject: DPA alignment: backup timelines, ephemeral log retention, and subprocessor evidence
messages:
From: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: secops@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify backup purge windows + ephemeral log retention under DPA

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this call last week. We're reviewing the DPA and want to confirm how Redwood treats backups and short-lived logs tied to debug sessions. Two specific asks from our side: 

1) Confirm the backup retention and purge cadence for customer-owned data snapshots (including automated nightly snapshots) and whether any carve-outs exist for marketplace images.

2) For ephemeral logs (debugging, request traces, ephemeral KV caches), we need to understand default retention, whether they reside in the same backup system, and options for a reduced retention window (30 days or less) with attestations.

Also, our legal team needs a short list of subprocessors that handle backups or long-term storage and any subcontractors used for cross-region replication. Can you send a short summary and a proposed language change to the DPA (we've attached suggested wording on our side) by EOD tomorrow?

Appreciate it —
Rebecca Lin
Acme Health, Senior Counsel

Attachment: Acme_DPA_comments_0310.pdf
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, legal@acmehealth.com, secops@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify backup purge windows + ephemeral log retention under DPA

Folks — looping in product and infra owners to propose a concrete plan for Acme's asks. High-level proposal attached. Key points: 

- Nightly snapshots (customer data) are retained for 90 days by default and purged on a rolling basis. We can offer a 30-day retention profile for regulated customers with a reserved capacity contract (Redwood Dedicated) and document a purge verification report on request.

- Ephemeral logs (request traces, debug-level logs, temporary KV caches) are retained 14 days by default in our hot log tier and are not copied into long-term backups. We can shorten to 30/14/7-day options per customer, and for Acme we propose a 30-day capped retention with an SLA that excludes debug dumps unless explicitly enabled by your engineers.

- Subprocessors: list attached (S3-compatible storage partner for long-term archive; regional replication partner). We'll provide SOC 2 evidence and a subprocessor addendum.

Action items: Kimberly, can you confirm the feasibility and cost delta for moving Acme to a 30-day snapshot purge profile and generate the backup-retention-matrix.xlsx? Aditya, please draft the DPA amendment text and a short attestation template for purge jobs. Marissa, loop in Customer Success to ensure Acme's onboarding team understands the change.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_proposal_v1.docx
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify backup purge windows + ephemeral log retention under DPA

Stephanie — quick feasibility notes after infra sync: 

- 30-day purge profile for nightly snapshots: feasible for Dedicated customers and for hosted customers via a retention tier flag. The difference is operational: hosted customers would be placed on a retention policy that triggers a daily purge job; Dedicated customers can opt for a localized retention policy that avoids cross-region replication for archives. Estimated monthly delta for storage and compute: +$1,400 for Acme's current dataset (ballpark, needs billing confirmation). I've started the backup-retention-matrix.xlsx (attached) with cost scenarios and replication behavior.

- Ephemeral logs: confirmed they live in the hot logging tier (14-day TTL) and are excluded from backup snapshots by design. We can support a 7-day TTL as an opt-in config for higher privacy needs; implementation ETA for opt-in flag is 3 weeks with a config-level roll-out.

- Subprocessors: we use CloudStore Inc. for cold archival and Replicor Ltd for cross-region replication. Both have SOC 2 Type II reports; I'll attach their cert links to the subprocessor addendum.

I'll coordinate with Billing to firm up the delta and with Product to prepare the attestation text.

—Kimberly
Director, Infrastructure Product
From: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: secops@acmehealth.com, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify backup purge windows + ephemeral log retention under DPA

Hi Stephanie / Kimberly,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and clear notes. A few follow-ups before we finalize the amendment: 

1) For audit purposes we need a monthly purge report for the first 6 months after switching to 30-day snapshots. That report should include timestamps of purge jobs, record counts affected, and a signed attestation from Redwood that the purge completed successfully. Doable?

2) The 7-day TTL option on ephemeral logs looks promising. Can you confirm whether traces that include PII fields are masked before storage in the hot tier, or if masking is only applied at index/ingest time? We need to document the masking behavior in the DPA language.

3) Please send the SOC 2 links for CloudStore Inc. and Replicor Ltd and confirm whether either subprocesses to additional vendors for replication.

If you can provide a redline of the DPA with the proposed language and the purge-report template by end of week, we can route to our InfoSec and procurement teams.

Best,
Rebecca Lin
Acme Health, Senior Counsel

--Onward actions (internal summary)
- Draft DPA redline with: 30-day snapshot retention profile, monthly purge report template (first 6 months), explicit statement that ephemeral logs are excluded from backups, and masking behavior for PII in hot tier. (Owner: aditya_rao)
- Finalize backup-retention-matrix.xlsx with cost delta and activation steps; confirm Billing delta. (Owner: kimberly_park)
- Produce subprocessor cert links and subprocessor addendum; attach CloudStore and Replicor SOC 2 links. (Owner: marissa_cole)
- Prepare purge attestation template and automated job hooks for monthly reporting. (Owner: stephanie_nguyen)

Sign-offs required: Product Security, Legal, Sales Ops (for any commercial delta).

Referenced attachments: DPA_Amendment_v2.pdf, backup-retention-matrix.xlsx

End of thread summary generated by: stephanie_nguyen
